title: Add AI Story & Image Studio to image
author: pollinations-ai[bot]
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds [AI Story & Image Studio](https://adventuretreehouse.com) to image
- A minimal interactive studio that generates short stories and matching illustrations simultaneously using Pollinations text and image APIs with seamless PKCE OAuth authentication.

Fixes #14114

gist.headline: Stories grow pictures now
gist.blurb: A new little treehouse has appeared in the garden. AI Story & Image Studio writes short adventures and draws their illustrations in the same breath.
gist.summary: Added AI Story & Image Studio, an interactive app at adventuretreehouse.com that simultaneously generates short stories and matching illustrations with Pollinations text and image APIs through PKCE OAuth.
gist.impact: People can now sign in seamlessly and turn a prompt into a paired story-and-image experience instead of stitching text and visuals together themselves.
gist.visual_concept: Depict a cozy treehouse writing studio where a story scroll becomes illustrated as it unrolls: a retro terminal produces both words and small framed scenes. Polli, wearing a tiny writer's beret, helps a friendly monitor robot hang the new illustrations among vines, flowers, and code-plants, representing seamless text-and-image creation and sign-in.
gist.image_prompt: Cozy pixel art scene inside a warm woodland story treehouse: a retro terminal glows lime green (#ecf874) as a scrolling story page transforms into matching tiny illustrated landscape panels, with flowers and code-plants growing around the desk. The main character is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings; she wears a tiny writer's beret and warmly helps a chunky CRT-monitor robot pin pictures to a vine-covered wall. Cozy 8-bit pixel art aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, subtle pixel-font text: 'STORY + IMAGE'.
